title: The Third Words
paragraphs: After parting ways with Itsuki, I escorted Ren back and then returned to the inn to sleep. Since I had been running around until quite late at night, the sun would be rising soon. And then, at dawn…

BANG BANG! A loud, frantic knocking on the door echoed through the inn. When I opened the door, the Crimson Swine charged at me, wailing with fake tears. Digging through my memories… I recall that at this point, I was supposed to catch her and then—
“What happened?”
“Bubububububu!”

If I remember correctly, she was about to claim that Father suddenly attacked her and almost raped her. She also mentioned that she spent a long time searching for the inn I was staying at to ask for help. Thinking about it now, that sounds incredibly suspicious. And she’s half-naked.
A pig running around the city half-naked in the middle of the night—what kind of play is this supposed to be?
“What?! I can’t believe it!”
“B-Buhi?”

Oh? Did I mess up my reaction? Still, the Crimson Swine continued squealing as if nothing was wrong. She must have ignored it. And since I was playing along, pretending to be sympathetic and concerned, she kept squealing as if everything was going smoothly for her.
“Then let’s go! We must summon Naofumi immediately and make sure he gets what he deserves!”

In a very small voice, I added, “You, that is.” Heh… I can’t wait. Leading the Crimson Swine along, I approached the guards stationed at the castle entrance. Before I could even say anything, the Crimson Swine rushed forward and started explaining the situation.
“…And that’s what happened. So we must hurry and call for an assembly.”
“Understood! Inform the king at once!”

Looking back now, I recall that the soldier had a smug grin on his face, which left me feeling disgusted. Relying on my memories, I then headed to Trash to report the situation. As expected, the bastard was already waiting in the throne room, fully prepared.

For an unexpected incident that happened in the middle of the night, shouldn’t there be more delays in responding? As I pondered that, the false accusation gained momentum and spiraled out of control. Soldiers were immediately dispatched from the castle to summon Ren and Itsuki. Messengers spread word of Father’s “crimes” throughout the town. Soon after, Ren and Itsuki arrived at the castle, listening to the soldiers and the Crimson Swine’s version of the story. Without exchanging words, the three of us locked eyes and nodded to each other.
“What?! Did he really do something like that to his own comrade?”
“Yes, that’s what we were told by Shield Hero-sama’s companion. If Spear Hero-sama hadn’t reported it, who knows what would have happened?”
“This is terrible… Trying to force himself on a comrade… and even making sure she couldn’t resist…”

Each of them gripped their weapons tightly, as if seething with anger. But my anger? It’s directed at you two. This time, there was no argument. The Crimson Swine continued playing the victim, spreading her lies while sobbing. But for those of us who knew the truth, her act was nothing but revolting. Itsuki, in particular, looked absolutely disgusted. The Crimson Swine and Trash probably thought he was furious at Father, but no. That anger was directed at them. And then, Father was dragged in, wearing nothing but his undergarments.

Ah… No matter how many times I see it, it’s a pitiful sight. That moment when the Crimson Swine stripped him down… I wanted to rush in and help immediately. But I had to endure it to gain Ren and Itsuki’s trust. Just hold on a little longer, Father. I’ll be by your side soon.
“Myne!”

Father called out to the Crimson Swine. He still didn’t understand what was happening. Soon, he would realize he had been caught in a trap and lash out in anger. I swear I will rescue him. I had already made up my mind—I would not let Father suffer the same despair as in the first world. Last time, I used the conspiracy to earn his trust. But this time, it wasn’t just him. Ren and Itsuki were with me as well. Trash and the Crimson Swine glared at Father. On the other hand, Ren and Itsuki cast sympathetic glances in his direction.
“W-What’s with those looks?”
Father was taken aback by the unexpected atmosphere.
“Are you sure you don’t remember anything?”

Of course, I knew he didn’t, but I played along for now. Standing firm, I approached Father, who was being restrained. This was our chance. Ren and Itsuki, pretending they couldn’t hold back their sense of justice, stepped forward as well.

We had already planned this. The three of us would move closer to Father together. This was Ren’s idea. Since soldiers were stationed near him, he suggested that we get as close as possible for safety. So, let’s reuse the same line I said in the first world.
“I don’t remember anything… Wait, ah—!”
Father’s eyes widened as he noticed the chainmail I was wearing.
“You’re the pillow thief!”
“Who are you calling a pillow thief?! I never expected them to be this vile!”
“‘Them’? ‘Vile’? What are you talking about?”
Father frowned in confusion. Of course, he didn’t know—this was a false accusation. The real villains here were Trash and the Crimson Swine.
“So, what exactly is the Shield Hero being accused of?”
“Accused? What are you talking about?”
“Buhi… Buhibuhibuhi!”
“Huh?”
“Bubububububu—Buhibuhibuhiii!”
The Crimson Swine, fake-crying, scurried behind me. Don’t come any closer. You stink like a pig. My nose is going to die.
“Buhihihihihi! Buhihi!”
“…What?”
Father’s expression shifted to one of sheer disbelief.
“What the hell are you saying? After I finished eating last night, I just went straight to my room and slept.”
“Lies! Then why is she crying like this?”
“Why the hell are you defending Myne? And more importantly, where did you get that chainmail?”
The Crimson Swine stole that from Father. The one who’s truly crying… is his heart!
“Ah, last night, she came to the tavern where I was drinking alone. We drank together for a while, and then she gave me this chainmail as a present.”
“…Huh?”
Father tilted his head repeatedly. Of course he did—he had absolutely no memory of this.
“That’s right! Your Majesty! While I was asleep, a pillow thief stole everything from me—my entire fortune and all my equipment except for my shield! Please, capture the culprit!”
“Silence, you fiend!”
Trash shouted in fake outrage. Despite orchestrating the whole conspiracy, he had the audacity to act like a victim. It disgusted me.
“Forcing yourself on a citizen of our kingdom is an unforgivable crime! If you weren’t a Hero, you would be executed on the spot!”
“I keep telling you, it’s a misunderstanding! I didn’t do anything!”
Father’s face was gradually turning pale. Just a little more… just a little more. For the final blow, I stepped closer to him.

Trash, the soldiers, and their lot were smirking, as if expecting me to kick him while he was down. But before that, Father turned his gaze to the Crimson Swine, and his expression twisted with fury. By then, Ren, Itsuki, and I had already closed the distance.
“You…! So you framed me just to steal my starting funds and equipment?!”
Father raised his voice and glared at me. I remained silent and moved even closer. The soldiers pushed him down even harder, as if trying to make me step on his face.
“You’ve got to be kidding me! You were after my money from the start, weren’t you?! You planned this with your allies to get better gear for them!”
Ah… His heart is breaking. I must save him—now.
“Coming to another world, only to be betrayed by your allies? That’s disgusting.”
“I agree. There’s no excuse for this. I had my doubts, but now I’m sure.”
“Indeed. Father—I’m here to save you!”
I swiftly took off the chainmail with one hand and slashed my spear at the soldiers restraining him.
“Waaaahhh!!”
Freed, Father stared in utter shock. I handed him the chainmail and helped him to his feet.
“Wha…? Huh?”
“Motoyasu-dono?!”
Trash gaped at us in disbelief. Father was equally confused by the sudden turn of events. I looked him straight in the eyes and spoke.
“I believe in you. You didn’t do this. This is all a conspiracy.”
“That’s right. Naofumi-san is innocent. No matter how hard they try, they can’t deceive us.”
“They tried to drive a wedge between us, to manipulate us for their own ends. But we refuse to play along.”
Ren and Itsuki pointed their weapons at Trash, the Crimson Swine, and the kingdom’s soldiers.
Yes…
I was here to protect Father. He was not alone. So please… stay strong.
“You’ve been running wild while the Queen is away. But tell me—what do you think she’ll say when she sees the state of this country?”
“Y-You…!”
Well, Trash wouldn’t back down just because I brought up the Queen. But it didn’t matter. Ren and Itsuki were standing with me. Their ambitions… were crushed.
“This is the third time I’ve stepped in to protect Father. So, let’s use the same words once more…”
Father looked up at me, stunned.
“I came from the future… to repay my debt to you, Father.”
